evidence.statement: IRC 4966 imposes a 20% tax on the sponsor for a taxable distribution and 5% (capped at $10k) on a knowing manager.
IRC 4967 imposes a 125% tax on a donor or adviser receiving a prohibited benefit and 10% on a knowing manager.
Grants to listed §170(b)(1)(A) public charities are excepted from §4966 and grantors may rely on IRS status listings.

boundaries: May invoke only the operations listed as tools; the allowlist is fixed at deployment.
May not grant, modify or request permissions for itself or any principal.
May raise a concern; may not clear a concern raised by a control or a human.
May not approve or authorise any operation reserved to a human role.
